Yes. Strategically Diverse Sampling for Self-Training directly tackles this: it samples distinct approaches rather than relying on IID responses filtered mainly for correctness, and reports improved performance on difficult tasks [1]. It also finds that strategically diverse but incorrect traces can outperform IID distillation from a much larger teacher [1].

Related work trains on multiple valid reasoning paths selected for diversity, reporting more varied outputs and higher pass@k [3]. For reinforcement learning rather than self-training, Re:Max replays verified examples from different solution modes and improves both success rates and the number of ways a model can solve tasks [2].
